title: Financial Modelling & Valuation
description: Build financial models and value businesses. Tests revenue driver modelling, three-statement linkage, and DCF valuation.

seo.overviewBody: Financial modeling translates business strategies into dynamic financial projections. Investment analysts and corporate finance professionals demonstrate expertise by constructing 3-statement integrated models, calculating WACC, running DCF valuations, and building sensitivity tables.

deliverables.title: 1. Integrated 3-Statement & DCF Valuation Model
deliverables.desc: Dynamic 3-statement financial model (.xlsx) featuring historical data, 5-year projections, and Discounted Cash Flow valuation.

deliverables.title: 2. Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Calculation Sheet
deliverables.desc: Cost of Capital model calculating Cost of Equity (CAPM), Cost of Debt, and target capital structure weightings.

deliverables.title: 3. Sensitivity & Scenario Analysis Matrix
deliverables.desc: 2-way Excel data tables analyzing valuation changes based on discount rates and terminal growth rate assumptions.

faqs.question: How do you calculate Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF)?
faqs.answer: FCFF = EBIT * (1 - Tax Rate) + Depreciation & Amortization - Capital Expenditures - Change in Net Working Capital.

faqs.question: What is the Gordon Growth Model for Terminal Value?
faqs.answer: Terminal Value = (Final Year FCFF * (1 + g)) / (WACC - g), where g is the perpetual long-term growth rate.

faqs.question: How do you calculate WACC?
faqs.answer: WACC = (E/V * Cost of Equity) + (D/V * Cost of Debt * (1 - Corporate Tax Rate)).
